items.q: Do all sociologists agree on how society works?
items.random_wrong: Functionalism and Marxism say the same thing.
items.why: Functionalism sees consensus; Marxism sees class conflict; feminism focuses on gender inequality.

items.q: What does the Marxist perspective emphasise?
items.correct: Conflict between social classes over power and resources.
items.misconception: That society runs on shared consensus with no conflict.
items.random_wrong: That gender is the only form of inequality.
items.why: Marxism focuses on class conflict; functionalism stresses consensus and order.
